formulas.ascii: Unit normal per cell from Horn gradients p = zFactor*(east - west 1-2-1 sums)/(8*wx), q = northSign*zFactor*(south - north 1-2-1 sums)/(8*wy): n = (-p, -q, 1)/|(-p, -q, 1)|. VRM = clamp(1 - |sum of n over the (2r+1)^2 window, clipped to the raster and to cells with a valid normal| / N, 0, 1), N = number of those cells. radius is a per-frame setting in [1, maximumRadius]. An invalid centre normal gives NaN. borderMode clamp repeats edge samples for the normals; nodata invalidates border normals.
